t: Rooted vs. Nomadic: How Ancient Human History Shaped a Modern Tech Stack
s: This article explores how the historical shift from nomadic to settled human life, paralleled with philosophical debates on human nature (Hobbes vs. Locke), informs the design of 'local-first' software like Pipulate, advocating for user control and digital sovereignty.
sub: Hobbes vs. Locke on human nature and governance
Digital nomadism and user data sovereignty
